Also FYI, the models do not have an opening database per se. They have internalized it in their weights (minds) via long training across a ton of games. I am sure AI labs train agentic AIs on different games and puzzles, including chess. Also, if you interact via chat, the only way for them to know the current position and think about next moves is their memory. AIs can store only so much context in one run, after a long time they may start acting a lot dumber as it fills out, or, especially in agentic AI, compact their knowledge. Compacting means it summarizes all they know from this convo into a smaller summary and start `fresh` with it. As others mentioned, this makes them effectively play blindfolded chess.
